summary: Context-only shadow deliberation: the US state is mixed and newly Q2/reflation, but regime confidence is low (0.195). Rates are the principal tension: real 10-year yields are 2.85% at a five-year extreme, breadth is weak, and cross-asset confirmation diverges. This does not justify escalation: the caution radar’s measured 21-session pullback incidence is 16.0% versus a 17.8% base rate, and no rate/inflation leg passed the scored forward-drawdown robustness bar. Liquidity quantity is expanding, but its quality is stress-expansion, the RRP buffer is exhausted, and the recent impulse is largely mechanical. Factor intelligence remains immature: only 10 panel dates, no scorecard survivors, composite untradeable, Pair G dormant, and factor-attention authority unearned. The graded-spine sample returned was dominated by unsigned MFE proxy observations and therefore cannot establish directional efficacy. No signal, trade, ranking change, or escalation is originated.

contradictions_review: Current graph shows seven display-only contradictions. The central cluster is Q2/reflation versus caution-level rate pressure and cross-asset divergence: bonds/FX agree only 50%, with both FX-dollar and rates-credit contradicting Q2. Liquidity is expanding in quantity but stress-confirming in quality. Forty ticker-level demand-versus-supply divergences remain unresolved. Options contradiction evidence is dated September 17 and is de-escalation context only. Factor Pair G has no records because the panel has not reached 60 dates. Open-thesis review also finds conflicts requiring operator attention: repeated Semiconductors-underweight theses conflict with current technology/semiconductor strength and confirmed memory leadership; Growth-over-value underweights conflict with IWF/IWD +3.83% over 20 days; the China-equities overweight conflicts with China Q4, contracting liquidity, and broken AI-compute leadership; Long Treasuries overweights conflict with the fired real-yield falsifier. These are ledger-maintenance and reassessment issues, not new directional claims.
